question: What is the meaning of compressive strength in relation to structural data?
description: Compressive strength refers to the ability of a material to withstand loads that tend to reduce its size, which is crucial for structural data in construction. It is a measure of the material's capacity to resist compression without undergoing deformation or failure. This property is essential for evaluating the suitability of materials for structural elements that will be subjected to compressive forces.
